couplets.en: This edge of sunlight as evening falls.

lines: Jo raat na din, jo aaj na kal
couplets.en: Day and night meet where there is neither day nor night, neither today nor tomorrow.

lines: Jo raat na din, jo aaj na kal
couplets.en: Neither night nor day, neither today nor tomorrow.
Deathless for a moment, smoke in the next.
This edge of sunlight as evening falls.

lines: Is dhoop kinare pal do pal
Honton ki lapak, baahon ki khanak
couplets.en: A moment or two at the edge of sunlight, a flash of lips and the chime of an embrace.
A flash of lips, this meeting of ours.

lines: Pal bhar ko amar, pal bhar mein dhuaan
couplets.en: This meeting of ours, deathless for a moment and smoke in the next.
This meeting of ours, this meeting of ours.
When the sun of this evening sinks into the sea of your eyes.
Those with homes will sleep in peace, and the traveler will go his way.
And the traveler will go his way.
Deathless for a moment, smoke in the next.
This edge of sunlight as evening falls.
